articles.title: Parish and Park Groups Team Up on Street Tree Planting
articles.deck: Residents of Foxglove Heights filled the hall on Thursday to ask questions about the plan.
body: Stella Bruckner, who has lived in Foxglove Heights for 9 years, said the response has been better than anyone expected. The group has raised $48,000 so far and is asking for help with supplies and food.

The Foxglove Heights Improvement Group will post updates on its bulletin board outside the library. The plan calls for street tree planting along Thistle Avenue, with work expected to start in November.

articles.title: Library Adds Senior Exercise Class This Fall
articles.deck: Doors open at 6 p.m. and the event is free to the public.
body: The event will be held at the Hickory Ridge rec center, rain or shine, with a backup date set for the following Friday.

Children are welcome, and volunteers will be on hand to help with parking and set-up. Doors open at 6 p.m. and the event is free to the public. Organizers ask guests to bring a dish to share or a little cash for supplies.

articles.deck: The work is expected to take 34 weeks and will be paid for with $7,500 raised locally.

articles.title: Carol Iwasaki, 75, Longtime Crossing Guard
articles.deck: Friends remember Carol Iwasaki for the many years of service to Bellwood.
body: Carol Iwasaki died in April at home on Ferry Street, at the age of 75. Born in Bellwood in the years after the war, Carol Iwasaki spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.

Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Eastgate Volunteer Fire Co. in his or her name. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Bellwood.

articles.title: Foxglove Heights Asks Council for Speed Limit Change
articles.deck: Supporters and opponents on Ridge Avenue disagreed about cost and timing.
body: Public works estimates the work will take about 23 weeks once it starts in April. Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days.
Councilmember Dolores Kozak asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $12,000.
